encounters.tier_hint_hint: An estimate from stats; you pick the tier. HP {{hp}}, SP {{sp}}, best combat skill {{skill}} (STAT + level). Thresholds are fitted to the book's 10 NPCs (p. 412-416): SP 10+ lieutenant, skill 13+ mini-boss, skill 16+ or HP 50+ boss. The book prints one boss, so its thresholds are the least certain.
encounters.import_empty: The export folder has no encounter files. Export at least one encounter or template first.

encounters.name: Name

encounters.templates_hint: A template appears when you open an NPC on the Characters tab and press "Save as template". The copy has full HP and SP and no injuries.

encounters.delete_encounter_body: Encounter "{{name}}" will be deleted. NPCs already launched into the session stay.
encounters.delete_template_body: Template "{{name}}" will be deleted. In encounters that use it the line shows "Template deleted" and is skipped on launch.
encounters.launched_missing: NPCs launched: {{count}}; skipped because of deleted templates: {{missing}}
encounters.players_hint: The group is the current session's player characters (PCs): encounters are compared with them.
encounters.no_players: No players in this session — add some to see the strength estimate.
encounters.strength_hint: Reference estimate, the GM decides. NPC weight in player slots: mook 1, lieutenant 2, mini-boss 3 (book p. 413-415: mooks match the edgerunners one to one, 1 lieutenant per 2, 1 mini-boss per 3). Boss = 6: the book gives no number, this is our estimate. Total {{weight}} against {{players}} players: up to 0.7 weak, up to 1.3 fair, up to 1.8 strong, above very strong. Own templates count by the tier you pick.
encounters.strength_skipped: NPCs not counted because of deleted templates: {{count}}

humanity.loss_roll: Roll {{notation}} (arrow: other dice and typing in faces)
humanity.cyberpsychosis_hint: HUM below zero: emotional death, cyberpsychosis (p. 80). Symptoms: no self-preservation, disregard for others, impulsive and explosive behavior (p. 108). The app applies no penalties; the GM plays the state out.
humanity.loss_hint: Take humanity off (an implant, a horrifying event)
humanity.therapy_hint: A week of therapy with a Medtech: win back some humanity
humanity.therapy_note: A Medtech cannot treat themselves. The week is spent on therapy. HUM is capped by the sheet's EMP.
humanity.bonus_hint: Rank of the Medicine ability + stat; typed in by the GM
humanity.declare_hint: Count the check as passed without rolling (the HUM dice are still rolled)

humanity.faces_invalid: Need the faces of {{dice}}, numbers 1 to 6
humanity.failed: failed: the week and the materials are wasted
